name: LFM3 model family (Liquid AI)
summary: Liquid AI's third-generation Liquid Foundation Models: open weights for six ~2B instances on one tri-hybrid backbone (LFM3-1.7B text, LFM3-VL-2B vision with video, LFM3-Audio-2B, LFM3-Omni-2B, plus d1-2B and d1-Omni-2B decision models), and LFM3-1.7B-Base. Built for on-device and edge use; GGUF, MLX, ONNX, FP8 and NVFP4 variants shipped at launch.

access.notes: Free incl. commercial use only for entities under $10M annual revenue; commercial use above that threshold is not licensed (non-profits exempt for research). Apache-style attribution/NOTICE terms. All 7 repos ungated.

procedure: Open the collection https://huggingface.co/collections/LiquidAI/lfm3 and pick a model (no login).
Download, e.g.: huggingface-cli download LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B (~3.5 GB), or the -GGUF / -ONNX / -FP8 / -NVFP4 / MLX variants listed on each card.
Read the LICENSE in the repo and check the $10M revenue threshold before commercial use.
Run with transformers (custom_code), llama.cpp, LM Studio, MLX or SGLang.

stats.count: 7 repos (6 instances + 1 base) plus quantized variants

verdict.why: Small, fast multimodal family that runs locally with many formats on day 0. Not OSI open source: the LFM Open License caps commercial use at $10M annual revenue. Links, license and image checked 2026-10-28.
